name: file-preview-drilldown
description: From a seeded assistant message, click a markdown file link to open the file-preview viewer, verify the markdown renderer, then open the SVG link and verify the image renderer.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="tab-"]')).filter((el) => { const id = el.getAttribute('data-testid') || ''; return id !== 'tab-bar' && id !== 'tab-bar-new' && !id.startsWith('tab-group-') && !id.startsWith('tab-rename-input-'); }); let opened = false; for (const tab of tabs) { tab.click(); await sleep(400); const toggle = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-toggle-view"]'); if (toggle instanceof HTMLElement) { toggle.click(); await sleep(400); } const link = document.querySelector('a[href$="preview-fixture.md"]'); if (link instanceof HTMLElement) { link.click(); await sleep(900); if (document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-file-viewer-panel"]') && document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-markdown"]')) { opened = true; break; } } } document.body.setAttribute('data-filepreview-md-opened', opened ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

metadata.label: Find the FILEPREVIEW_SEED session and open the markdown fixture link

assert.failure_message: Expected the markdown file link to open the file-preview viewer with the markdown renderer (seed.sh hook seeding may be unavailable)

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); await sleep(400); const link = document.querySelector('a[href$="preview-fixture.svg"]'); let opened = false; if (link instanceof HTMLElement) { link.click(); await sleep(900); if (document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-file-viewer-panel"]') && document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-image"]')) { opened = true; } } document.body.setAttribute('data-filepreview-svg-opened', opened ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

assert.failure_message: Expected the SVG file link to open the file-preview viewer with the image renderer
